## 📋 Contributor Verification Checklist

Please verify and check all applicable boxes prior to requesting review:

- [ ] **Tests Pass:** All server tests (`npm test`, `npm run test:smoke`) and client tests (`npm test`) pass locally.
- [ ] **Coverage Thresholds:** New or changed server code has tests; coverage thresholds still pass.
- [ ] **Documentation Sync:** **If I renamed/moved/added an endpoint, env var, script, or file, I updated `docs/` and `docs/README.md` (index).**
- [ ] **Documentation Guardrails:** Executed `npm run docs:check` locally; `README.md` is under 8 KB and all relative links/anchors resolve cleanly.
- [ ] **No Secrets Committed:** No actual tokens, keys, passwords, or credentials are added in code or documentation.
- [ ] **Clean Lint & Build:** Client passes `npm run build` and server passes syntax checks.
